notes: Free Pascal fixes_3_2 Windows x64 snapshot ZIP from downloads.freepascal.org. Use the `fpc64` command in OpenMind terminals to compile .pas/.pp files into Windows x64 programs with the bundled RTL units. The stable 3.2.2 Windows x64 page does not ship a native x64 compiler package, so this uses the official single-ZIP snapshot that can be extracted portably. `fpc64` is a small OpenMind shim over ppcrossx64.exe.
